reviews.t: I love them! They don't feel like plastic at all ...

They were in a small cute little white package. The strip is very thin, not like normal lashes you buy at Target or Wal-Mart but I like that better because it looks more natural to me but it still looks like you applied eyeliner on your eyes. I love them! $3.99 for a pack of 10 is what you pay for 1 pair at the store

These lashes are great! They look very natural. A little tricky to put on bc they are thin at the strip and flimsy but if u take your time to put them on right then they make your eyes more beautiful! And the strip just looks like you have on black eyeliner and naturally long curly lashes that wisp out at the end like dolls lashes.
if you want a very natural look (not too dense) these are great - good for everyday but would opt for a fuller look for evening out.
i stacked these lashes and i've worn them multiple times they're so great. my lashes have never looked better for sure repurchasing!

These lashes are lightweight and look very natural if applied correctly. I trim them, cut them in half so I can usually get 2 uses from each pair, and apply the lashes under my natural lashes NOT on top. Since the band on these is not clear (it's a thin thread) I think applying under is the best way to camouflage and blend with my lashes. LOVE these lashes. I order them in bulk frequently! Very natural look for being faux. Not as heavy as most falsies. AND, they're way cheaper than paying $5 for one pair at most stores. Love love love. I will be placing my next order soon :)  (Photo is the lashes WITH mascara)

These were a lot better than I expected them to be!  I use Ardell Wispies a lot and these are just like those lashes! They are lightweight and comfortable! Natural but flirty. I did have to cut them down a little bit on both sides, but still very adorable. Definitely a deal!

I use these with a dark lash adhesive since white glue is pretty noticeable on my eyelashes. But these are great, for a great price, super fast shipping, and they look natural once you've trimmed them up a bit.
